signal: Ever.Ag is extending its Everett agentic AI decision engine to Agribusiness, with announcements planned for summer 2026.

email.body1:
Phil, saw Everett is rolling into Agribusiness next, with announcements lined up for this summer.

A push like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can work before reps are stretched thin, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Ever.Ag's agribusiness motion off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Phil, quick follow-up for Ever.Ag.

Ahead of an Everett launch, demand often outpaces what the team can cover, and most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit target this quarter. So the gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the agribusiness team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Phil, last bit of proof for Ever.Ag.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ever.Ag's reply rate likely compares to other AgTech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Phil, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you launch Everett for agribusiness, no problem at all. Timing matters around a launch, and I know it keeps a sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your agribusiness motion? I will tailor it to Ever.Ag either way.
